orbital-composition.scope: Documented eleven-molecule everyday-QC same-wavefunction post-processing scope; conditioning and normalization failures remain partial or Experimental.

mayer.scope: Documented eleven-molecule everyday-QC same-wavefunction post-processing scope with charge/spin conservation checks.

dos.scope: Orbital-energy Gaussian broadening for the documented everyday-QC reference scope; this is not an excited-state spectrum.

pdos.scope: Documented atom/element/angular projection scope with representation-dependent projection conventions and explicit sum-rule diagnostics.

point-esp.scope: Native Gaussian-integral electronic point ESP for the committed everyday-QC reference points and documented work/convergence limits.

hirshfeld.scope: Ordinary neutral-pro-atom Hirshfeld populations and charges for H/C/N/O all-electron wavefunctions in the named ten-case validation set, including charged and open-shell cases. Unrestricted inputs use the total density. Unsupported elements, ECP/pseudopotential cases, and ghost-center ambiguity remain unsupported.

vibrational-spectroscopy.scope: Native source-faithful Gaussian harmonic vibrational parsing, IR intensities, Raman activities, source normal-mode vectors and deterministic Gaussian broadening. Committed fixtures and interface-parity tests establish implementation/regression behavior but are not an independent external scientific validation campaign. Raman activity is not converted to experimental Raman intensity.

excited-states-uvvis.scope: Source-faithful excited-state records for the implemented Gaussian, ORCA and Q-Chem adapters, conservative method/amplitude conventions, transition dipoles when reported, and deterministic UV–Vis post-processing with explicit oscillator-strength eligibility and energy-to-wavelength Jacobian handling. Current evidence establishes parser, mathematical and interface behavior but is not an independent cross-program scientific validation campaign.

everyday_qc_corpus.note: Per-input SHA-256 values are recorded in the reference report. Packaging regressions require the installed Molden inputs to be byte-identical to this versioned source corpus.

resource_benchmark.purpose: Checks bounded command completion, runtime, observed RSS and generated-output size for prescribed real workflows. Scientific status is evaluated by capability-specific reference tests and result diagnostics.

everyday-qc/report.json.purpose: Historical water/methane/ammonia regression snapshot. Values remain useful for regression history but its top-level/record validation labels are not the current capability registry.

everyday-qc/esp-report.json.purpose: Historical grid-ESP convergence capture retained to document successes and the ammonium partial case. It is not the current status source for native integral point ESP.

legacy_fixture_registry_note: The cases array below is the older core-FCHK validation registry used by the legacy validation runner. Its pending v0.7 slots are historical fixture gaps and do not mean that the corresponding 0.10 everyday-QC Molden examples are absent. Current everyday-QC coverage is recorded separately above.
